title: The Dark Fountain
description: Adds a Dark Fountain from the hit game Deltarune.
body:
A datapack for Minecraft that allows you to open Dark Fountains and close them, just like in the hit game Deltarune! How to use:
1.Get an Iron Sword and right click any block to open a fountain
2.Throw a Nether Star near a fountain to close it.
3.Throw any item near the fountain to turn it into a Darkner!
